paragraphs.source_en: Overawed by Mototada's commanding presence, the man took a step back. “I serve Nomura, Governor of Higo.”

units.source_en: Overawed by Mototada's commanding presence, the man took a step back.
units.source_zh: 在元忠威严气势的震慑下，对方退了一步。

units.source_en: “I serve Nomura, Governor of Higo.”
units.source_zh: “野村肥后守手下。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 在元忠威严气势的震慑下，对方退了一步。“野村肥后守手下。”

paragraphs.source_en: Magohachirō took another step back. Mototada was far too composed, and Magohachirō shrank back all the more.

units.source_en: Magohachirō took another step back.
units.source_zh: 孙一郎又向后退了一步。

units.source_en: Mototada was far too composed, and Magohachirō shrank back all the more.
units.source_zh: 元忠太沉着了，他越发畏缩起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 孙一郎又向后退了一步。元忠太沉着了，他越发畏缩起来。

paragraphs.source_en: At these words, Magohachirō flung himself at Mototada's feet and placed both hands on the ground. “My lord, please do not say such a thing.”

units.source_en: At these words, Magohachirō flung himself at Mototada's feet and placed both hands on the ground.
units.source_zh: 听到这话，孙一郎猛扑到元忠脚下，两手触地。

units.source_en: “My lord, please do not say such a thing.”

ja.t: 、そのようなことをおっしゃらないでください」

units.source_zh: “大人不要这么说。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 听到这话，孙一郎猛扑到元忠脚下，两手触地。“大人不要这么说。”

units.source_en: “What did you say?”
units.source_zh: “你说什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I, Saika Magohachirō, have never... never encountered a commander as valiant and spirited as you, my lord.”

units.source_en: “I, Saika Magohachirō, have never... never encountered a commander as valiant and spirited as you, my lord.”

ja.t: ったことはございません」

units.source_zh: “杂贺孙一郎从来……从来没遇到大人这般勇猛、这般血性的大将。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “杂贺孙一郎从来……从来没遇到大人这般勇猛、这般血性的大将。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hah! A moment ago, I told you to hurry up, kill me, and claim your reward. Do not lose your nerve. Get up—get up and kill me! I have already thrust this white-haired head out before you.” Mototada hastily stripped off his armor.

units.source_en: “Hah! A moment ago, I told you to hurry up, kill me, and claim your reward.
units.source_zh: “嘿，我方才要你赶快杀掉我去请功。

units.source_en: Do not lose your nerve.
units.source_zh: 休要畏怯。

units.source_en: Get up—get up and kill me!
units.source_zh: 起来，起来杀掉我！

units.source_en: I have already thrust this white-haired head out before you.”
units.source_zh: 我已把这颗白发苍苍的脑袋伸向你了。”

units.source_en: Mototada hastily stripped off his armor.
units.source_zh: 元忠匆匆脱掉盔甲。

paragraphs.source_zh: “嘿，我方才要你赶快杀掉我去请功。休要畏怯。起来，起来杀掉我！我已把这颗白发苍苍的脑袋伸向你了。”元忠匆匆脱掉盔甲。

units.source_en: “You would have me commit seppuku?”
units.source_zh: “你让我切腹？”

units.source_en: “Just so.”
units.source_zh: “正是。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Hah! Never in my wildest dreams did I expect such a thing. Am I truly so noble? In your eyes, is Mototada truly a commander of such spirit?”

units.source_en: “Hah! Never in my wildest dreams did I expect such a thing. Am I truly so noble?

ja.t: いもよらなんだ。わしはそれほど

units.source_zh: “嘿，这可是老夫万万没想到的事，我有那般高贵？

units.source_en: In your eyes, is Mototada truly a commander of such spirit?”
units.source_zh: 在你眼里，元忠真的是一位血性大将？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “嘿，这可是老夫万万没想到的事，我有那般高贵？在你眼里，元忠真的是一位血性大将？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Both your valor in the attack and the words you spoke just now make you a model for every warrior in the realm.”

units.source_en: “Both your valor in the attack and the words you spoke just now make you a model for every warrior in the realm.”
units.source_zh: “无论是大人勇猛的进攻，还是大人刚才的话语，都堪称天下武将的楷模。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “无论是大人勇猛的进攻，还是大人刚才的话语，都堪称天下武将的楷模。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha ha ha ha! Those are the sweetest words I have heard in all my life. Your words are worth more than a million recitations of the sutras.”

units.source_en: “Ha ha ha ha!
units.source_zh: “哈哈哈哈。

units.source_en: Those are the sweetest words I have heard in all my life.
units.source_zh: 这可是我一生听到的最好听的话。

units.source_en: Your words are worth more than a million recitations of the sutras.”
units.source_zh: 你的话真是胜过百万遍诵经啊。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哈哈哈哈。这可是我一生听到的最好听的话。你的话真是胜过百万遍诵经啊。”

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, he no longer had even the strength to draw the blade once across his belly.

units.source_en: In truth, he no longer had even the strength to draw the blade once across his belly.
units.source_zh: 实际上，他连横切一刀的力气都没有了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 实际上，他连横切一刀的力气都没有了。

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord has taken his own life!”

units.source_en: “My lord has taken his own life!”
units.source_zh: “大人自尽了！”

units.source_en: “The castellan has committed seppuku!”
units.source_zh: “城代大人切腹了！”

paragraphs.source_en: At that moment, the survivors too realized that further resistance was futile. Of the sixteen men, only five or six now remained. They rushed to Mototada's remains and, as one, set their blades against their throats. At that very instant, the attacking troops surged in.

units.source_en: At that moment, the survivors too realized that further resistance was futile.
units.source_zh: 此时，剩余的人亦知他们的抵抗已无意义了。

units.source_en: Of the sixteen men, only five or six now remained.
units.source_zh: 十六个人此时只剩下五六人。

units.source_en: They rushed to Mototada's remains and, as one, set their blades against their throats.
units.source_zh: 他们奔到元忠的遗骸旁边，不约而同把利刃对准了脖子。

units.source_en: At that very instant, the attacking troops surged in.
units.source_zh: 恰在此时，进攻的军队猛地拥了进来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时，剩余的人亦知他们的抵抗已无意义了。十六个人此时只剩下五六人。他们奔到元忠的遗骸旁边，不约而同把利刃对准了脖子。恰在此时，进攻的军队猛地拥了进来。

paragraphs.source_en: Mototada took his own life at the age of sixty-two.

units.source_en: Mototada took his own life at the age of sixty-two.
units.source_zh: 元忠自尽，享年六十二岁。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元忠自尽，享年六十二岁。

paragraphs.source_en: Three hundred and fifty-four Torii retainers died alongside Mototada. Not one survived, from the senior retainers to the lowest-ranking warriors; some fell in battle, while others took their own lives. Just as Mototada had hoped, Fushimi Castle fell only after striking terror into the hearts of the vast attacking army.

units.source_en: Three hundred and fifty-four Torii retainers died alongside Mototada.
units.source_zh: 与元忠共同战死的鸟居家臣三百五十四人。

units.source_en: Not one survived, from the senior retainers to the lowest-ranking warriors; some fell in battle, while others took their own lives.

units.source_zh: 正如元忠所期，在让进攻的大军胆战心寒之后，伏见城陷落。

paragraphs.source_zh: 与元忠共同战死的鸟居家臣三百五十四人。从重臣到下级武士无一生者，或战死，或自尽。正如元忠所期，在让进攻的大军胆战心寒之后，伏见城陷落。
